blocks.text: **every** va **all** ning asosiy farqini bilasiz: **every** + birlikdagi ot (every day — har kuni), **all** + ko'plik yoki sanalmaydigan ot (all students, all the money) (→ qizil kitob, 80-dars). Bu darsda uchta nozik masala bor: 1) nega «All came» emas, **Everybody came**; 2) **whole** («butun, to'liq») all dan qanday farq qiladi; 3) vaqt bilan **every day** (har kuni), **all day** (kun bo'yi) va **the whole day** (butun kun) farqi. O'zbekchada ham uchta so'z bor — «hamma / barcha», «har», «butun» — lekin ularning chegaralari inglizchadagi bilan to'liq mos kelmaydi.

O'zbekchada «Hamma keldi», «Hammasini yo'qotdim» deymiz. Inglizchada esa yolg'iz **all** odatda ega yoki to'ldiruvchi bo'lib kelmaydi: odamlar uchun — **everybody / everyone**, narsalar uchun — **everything**. «All came» o'rniga **Everybody** came; «I've lost all» o'rniga I've lost **everything**. Lekin **all** + gap bir maxsus ma'noni beradi: «**faqat shu, boshqa hech narsa**». **All** I want is sleep — Menga **faqat** uyqu kerak. **All** she said was «No». Bu ma'noda everything ishlatilmaydi. all of us / all of them esa to'g'ri (→ 88-dars).

rows: Everything I need is a holiday.

items.text: **Everybody** laughed when the teacher fell off his chair.
**All** I had in my pocket was a bus ticket.

blocks.text: **whole** — «butun, to'liq, boshidan oxirigacha». U asosan **birlikdagi sanaladigan ot** bilan keladi va the / my / a dan **keyin** turadi: **the whole** day, **my whole** life, **a whole** pizza. all bilan tartib boshqacha: **all the** cake = **the whole** cake. **Sanalmaydigan ot** bilan whole ishlatilmaydi: **all the** money («the whole money» — xato). Shahar, mamlakat nomlari va the oldidan — **the whole of**: **the whole of** London. Ko'plikdagi ot bilan whole «to'liq-to'liq, butun-butun» degani: **Whole** villages were flooded — Butun-butun qishloqlarni suv bosdi.

items.text: Jasur ate **a whole** melon by himself.
items.translation: Jasur **butun** bir qovunni o'zi yeb qo'ydi.

items.text: She spent **all the** money her parents gave her.
items.translation: U ota-onasi bergan **hamma** pulni sarflab qo'ydi.

items.text: **The whole of** Samarkand was decorated for the holiday.

blocks.text: Vaqt bilan: every day, all day, the whole day

**every day / every week** — «har kuni, har hafta»: harakat **qanchalik tez-tez** takrorlanadi. **all day / all week / all night** (the siz!) va **the whole day / the whole week** — «kun bo'yi, hafta bo'yi»: harakat **qancha davom etadi**. I work **every day** — Har kuni ishlayman. I worked **all day** — Kun bo'yi ishladim. **every** + son + ko'plik: **every two weeks** (har ikki haftada), **every ten minutes**; **every other** day — kunora; **every single** — har bir, bittasini ham qoldirmay.

items.translation: Madina **har** kuni ertalab ishdan oldin suzadi.

items.text: We were stuck at the airport **all** night.
The trains to Oxford leave **every half hour**.

blocks.text: every / everybody + birlik fe'l, lekin they

**every, everybody, everyone, everything** ma'nosi bo'yicha ko'plikka o'xshasa ham, fe'l **birlikda** keladi: **Every** student **has** a card. **Everyone is** here. Olmosh sifatida esa ko'pincha **they / them / their** ishlatiladi: **Everyone** brought **their** own food. every va **each** farqi — keyingi darsda (→ 91-dars).

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «All came to the meeting» → **Everybody** came; «I lost all» → I lost **everything**; «every days», «every students» → **every day**, **every student** (birlik!); «Everybody are happy» → Everybody **is** happy; «the whole money», «whole the day» → **all the** money, **the whole** day; «all the day» (kun bo'yi) → **all day**.

O'zbekchaga qarab tanlang: «**har** ...» → every; «... **bo'yi**» (kun bo'yi, tun bo'yi) → all day / the whole day; «**butun** ...» + birlikdagi ot → the whole; «**faqat** ..., xolos» → All ... is ...; «**hamma**» yolg'iz → everybody / everything.

examples.title: **everybody**, **everything** — not **all**
examples.description: So'zlashuvda all yolg'iz «hamma odam» yoki «hamma narsa» ma'nosida deyarli ishlatilmaydi: Everybody came (All came emas), I've lost everything (I've lost all emas).

sentences.text: **Everybody** in the office signed the birthday card for Madina.
sentences.translation: Ofisdagi **hamma** Madina uchun tug'ilgan kun otkritkasiga imzo chekdi.

sentences.text: The burglars took **everything** of value, even my grandmother's ring.
sentences.translation: O'g'rilar qimmatbaho **hamma narsani**, hatto buvimning uzugini ham olib ketishdi.

sentences.text: Is **everyone** ready? The bus leaves in five minutes.
sentences.translation: **Hamma** tayyormi? Avtobus besh daqiqadan keyin jo'naydi.

sentences.text: **Everything** in this shop costs less than five pounds.
sentences.translation: Bu do'kondagi **hamma narsa** besh funtdan arzon.

sentences.text: I've told you **everything** I know about the accident.
sentences.translation: Avariya haqida bilganlarimning **hammasini** sizga aytdim.

sentences.text: **Everybody** was talking about the match the next day.
sentences.translation: Ertasi kuni **hamma** o'yin haqida gapirardi.

sentences.text: The guide explained **everything** clearly, so **everyone** understood the history of the Ark.
sentences.translation: Gid **hamma narsani** tushunarli qilib aytib berdi, shuning uchun **hamma** Ark tarixini tushundi.

sentences.text: Thanks for **everything** — I couldn't have done it without you.
sentences.translation: **Hamma narsa** uchun rahmat — sizsiz buni uddalay olmasdim.

sentences.text: Not **everyone** agrees with the new parking rules in the city centre.
sentences.translation: Shahar markazidagi yangi to'xtash qoidalariga **hamma ham** qo'shilmaydi.

sentences.text: After the flood, the family lost **everything**, but **everybody** in the village helped them.
sentences.translation: Sel kelganidan keyin oila **hamma narsasidan** ayrildi, lekin qishloqdagi **hamma** ularga yordam berdi.

examples.title: **all** = the only thing: **All** I want is ...
examples.description: all (that) + gap — «faqat shu, boshqa hech narsa»: All I need is sleep — Menga faqat uyqu kerak. Bu ma'noda everything ishlatilmaydi.

sentences.text: **All** I want for my birthday is a quiet day at home.
sentences.translation: Tug'ilgan kunimda **faqat** uyda tinch bir kun o'tkazishni **xohlayman**.

sentences.text: **All** she said was 'Sorry', and then she left the room.
sentences.translation: U **faqat** «Kechirasiz» **dedi**-yu, xonadan chiqib ketdi.

sentences.text: I'm starving! **All** I've eaten today is one banana.
sentences.translation: Qornim juda och! Bugun **faqat** bitta banan **yedim**.

sentences.text: **All** you need to open an account is your passport.
sentences.translation: Hisob ochish uchun sizga **faqat** pasportingiz **kerak**.

sentences.text: We had a terrible holiday — **all** it did was rain.
sentences.translation: Ta'tilimiz dahshatli o'tdi — **faqat** yomg'ir **yog'di**.

sentences.text: The doctor said that **all** I needed was rest and plenty of water.
sentences.translation: Shifokor menga **faqat** dam olish va ko'p suv ichish **kerakligini** aytdi.

sentences.text: That's **all** I can tell you — the rest is confidential.
sentences.translation: Sizga ayta oladiganim **shu, xolos** — qolgani maxfiy.

sentences.text: From the plane, **all** we could see was cloud.
sentences.translation: Samolyotdan **faqat** bulutni **ko'ra oldik**.

sentences.text: Jasur doesn't care about money — **all** he cares about is his family.
sentences.translation: Jasur pulga qiziqmaydi — uni **faqat** oilasi **qiziqtiradi**.

sentences.text: There's no need for a big party — **all** Grandma wants is to see the family together.
sentences.translation: Katta ziyofat shart emas — buvim **faqat** oilani birga ko'rishni **xohlaydi**.

examples.title: **whole** = complete: the **whole** day, my **whole** life
examples.description: whole — «butun, to'liq, boshidan oxirigacha». Birlikdagi sanaladigan ot bilan, the / my / a dan keyin: the whole day, my whole life, a whole pizza.

sentences.text: Oliver ate **a whole** pizza by himself and then complained about feeling sick.
sentences.translation: Oliver **butun** bir pitsani o'zi yeb qo'ydi, keyin ko'ngli aynayotganidan shikoyat qildi.

sentences.text: I've lived in Tashkent **my whole** life, and I still get lost in the old city.
sentences.translation: **Butun umrim** Toshkentda o'tdi, lekin eski shaharda hali ham adashib qolaman.

sentences.text: **The whole** family came to the airport to say goodbye to Aziz.
sentences.translation: Azizni kuzatish uchun aeroportga **butun oila** keldi.

sentences.text: Did you read **the whole** book in one night? That's amazing!
sentences.translation: **Butun** kitobni bir kechada o'qib chiqdingmi? Ajoyib!

sentences.text: The noise from the building site went on for **the whole** morning.
sentences.translation: Qurilish maydonidagi shovqin **ertalab bo'yi** davom etdi.

sentences.text: Sarah told me **the whole** story, from beginning to end.
sentences.translation: Sara menga voqeani **to'liq**, boshidan oxirigacha aytib berdi.

sentences.text: **The whole** point of the trip was to relax, but we worked every day.
sentences.translation: Sayohatning **butun maqsadi** dam olish edi, lekin har kuni ishladik.

sentences.text: Bekzod spent **a whole** month's salary on a new phone.
sentences.translation: Bekzod yangi telefonga **bir oylik maoshini to'liq** sarfladi.

sentences.text: When the power went off, **whole** streets were in darkness for hours.
sentences.translation: Tok o'chganda **butun-butun** ko'chalar soatlab qorong'ilikda qoldi.

sentences.text: Kate was so nervous that her **whole** body was shaking before the interview.
sentences.translation: Keyt shunchalik hayajonlandiki, suhbatdan oldin **butun** vujudi titrardi.

examples.title: **all the** money, **the whole** cake, **the whole of**
examples.description: all the cake = the whole cake (so'z tartibiga e'tibor bering). Sanalmaydigan ot bilan faqat all: all the money. Nomlar oldida — the whole of.

sentences.text: The kids finished **the whole** cake before the guests arrived.
sentences.translation: Bolalar mehmonlar kelguncha **butun** tortni yeb bitirishdi.

sentences.text: Who drank **all the** milk? There's none left for my coffee.
sentences.translation: **Hamma** sutni kim ichib qo'ydi? Qahvamga bir tomchi ham qolmabdi.

sentences.text: Jasur spent **all his** money on concert tickets.
sentences.translation: Jasur **bor pulini** konsert chiptalariga sarfladi.

sentences.text: **All the** information is on the website, so you don't need to call.
sentences.translation: **Barcha** ma'lumot saytda bor, qo'ng'iroq qilishingiz shart emas.

sentences.text: The storm affected **the whole of** Scotland last weekend.
sentences.translation: O'tgan dam olish kunlari bo'ron **butun** Shotlandiyaga ta'sir qildi.

sentences.text: It rained for **the whole of** our stay in Edinburgh.
sentences.translation: Edinburgda bo'lgan **butun vaqtimiz** davomida yomg'ir yog'di.

sentences.text: **All the** furniture in the flat is new, so please be careful with it.
sentences.translation: Kvartiradagi **barcha** mebel yangi, iltimos, ehtiyot bo'ling.

sentences.text: My cousin knows **the whole of** Bukhara like the back of his hand.
sentences.translation: Amakivachcham **butun** Buxoroni besh qo'lday biladi.

sentences.text: Did you spend **the whole** weekend studying? — No, not **all** of it.
sentences.translation: **Butun** dam olish kunlarini dars qilib o'tkazdingmi? — Yo'q, **hammasini** emas.

sentences.text: Nilufar used **all the** flour in the house to bake bread for **the whole** street.
sentences.translation: Nilufar **butun** mahallaga non yopish uchun uydagi **hamma** unni ishlatdi.

examples.title: **every** day or **all** day? The **whole** day
examples.description: every day — har kuni (qanchalik tez-tez), all day / the whole day — kun bo'yi (qancha vaqt). all day, all night, all week — the siz.

sentences.text: Bekzod goes to the gym **every** morning before work.
sentences.translation: Bekzod **har** kuni ertalab ishdan oldin sport zaliga boradi.

sentences.text: Yesterday it snowed **all day**, so we stayed inside.
sentences.translation: Kecha **kun bo'yi** qor yog'di, shuning uchun uyda qoldik.

sentences.text: Dilnoza calls her mother **every** evening, even when she's busy.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza band bo'lsa ham, **har** kuni kechqurun onasiga qo'ng'iroq qiladi.

sentences.text: The baby cried **all night**, and nobody got any sleep.
sentences.translation: Chaqaloq **tun bo'yi** yig'ladi, hech kim uxlay olmadi.

sentences.text: I've been in meetings **the whole** afternoon, and I'm exhausted.
sentences.translation: **Tushdan keyin bo'yi** majlislarda o'tirdim, juda charchadim.

sentences.text: We visited a different museum **every day** of our holiday in London.
sentences.translation: Londondagi ta'tilimizning **har kuni** boshqa muzeyga bordik.

sentences.text: Are you going to sit at the computer **all weekend**?
sentences.translation: **Dam olish kunlari bo'yi** kompyuter oldida o'tirmoqchimisan?

sentences.text: The little bakery on our corner bakes fresh bread **every day** except Sunday.
sentences.translation: Muyulishimizdagi kichkina novvoyxona yakshanbadan tashqari **har kuni** yangi non yopadi.

sentences.text: Tom works from home **every** Friday, but on Mondays he's in the office **all day**.
sentences.translation: Tom **har** juma uydan ishlaydi, dushanba kunlari esa **kun bo'yi** ofisda bo'ladi.

sentences.text: It's been raining **the whole** week, and the river is getting dangerously high.
sentences.translation: **Butun hafta** yomg'ir yog'yapti, daryo xavfli darajada ko'tarilib boryapti.

examples.title: **every two weeks**, **every other** day, **every single**
examples.description: every + son + ko'plik — «har ikki haftada», «har o'n daqiqada». every other — «kunora, bir ... ora». every single — «har bir, bittasini ham qoldirmay». every time — «har safar».

sentences.text: The buses to the airport run **every twenty minutes** during the day.
sentences.translation: Kunduzi aeroportga avtobuslar **har yigirma daqiqada** qatnaydi.

sentences.text: You should change your password **every three months**.
sentences.translation: Parolingizni **har uch oyda** almashtirib turishingiz kerak.

sentences.text: Emma visits her grandparents in Manchester **every other** weekend.
sentences.translation: Emma Manchesterdagi bobosi va buvisini **ikki haftada bir** dam olish kunida ko'rgani boradi.

sentences.text: Take one tablet **every eight hours**, preferably after food.
sentences.translation: **Har sakkiz soatda** bittadan tabletka iching, imkon qadar ovqatdan keyin.

sentences.text: In summer I water the tomatoes **every other** day.
sentences.translation: Yozda pomidorlarni **kunora** sug'oraman.

sentences.text: Our team meets **every two weeks** to discuss the project.
sentences.translation: Jamoamiz loyihani muhokama qilish uchun **har ikki haftada** yig'iladi.

sentences.text: Aziz checks his phone **every few minutes**, even during dinner.
sentences.translation: Aziz hatto kechki ovqat paytida ham **har bir necha daqiqada** telefoniga qaraydi.

sentences.text: The actress remembered **every single** word of her long speech.
sentences.translation: Aktrisa uzun monologining **har bir** so'zini **qoldirmay** eslab qoldi.

sentences.text: **Every time** I visit Samarkand, I discover something new.
sentences.translation: Samarqandga **har safar** borganimda yangi narsa kashf qilaman.

sentences.text: Seriously, the printer breaks down **every single** week!
sentences.translation: Jiddiy aytyapman, printer **har hafta**, bittasini qoldirmay, buziladi!

examples.title: **every** / **everyone** + singular verb; **their**
examples.description: every, everybody, everyone, everything dan keyin fe'l birlikda (every student has, everyone is). Olmosh sifatida ko'pincha they / them / their keladi.

sentences.text: **Every** room in the hotel **has** a view of the mountains.
sentences.translation: Mehmonxonadagi **har bir** xonadan tog'lar **ko'rinadi**.

sentences.text: **Everyone** in our class **has** a smartphone except me.
sentences.translation: Sinfimizda mendan boshqa **hammada** smartfon **bor**.

sentences.text: **Everything** **was** ready when the guests arrived.
sentences.translation: Mehmonlar kelganda **hamma narsa** tayyor **edi**.

sentences.text: **Everybody** **wants** to be happy, but **they** don't always know how.
sentences.translation: **Har kim** baxtli bo'lishni **xohlaydi**, lekin buni qanday qilishni doim ham bilmaydi.

sentences.text: **Every** child **needs** love and attention, especially in the first years.
sentences.translation: **Har bir** bolaga, ayniqsa birinchi yillarda, mehr va e'tibor **kerak**.

sentences.text: Please ask **everyone** to bring **their** own laptop to the training.
sentences.translation: Iltimos, **hammaga** treningga **o'z** noutbukini olib kelishni ayting.

sentences.text: Has **everybody** got **their** tickets? We're about to board.
sentences.translation: **Hammaning** chiptasi qo'lidami? Hozir samolyotga chiqamiz.

sentences.text: **Every** one of these photos **is** blurred — what happened to the camera?
sentences.translation: Bu suratlarning **har biri** xira chiqqan — kameraga nima bo'ldi?

sentences.text: In my family, **everyone** **gets** up early, even at the weekend.
sentences.translation: Oilamizda **hamma** erta **turadi**, hatto dam olish kunlari ham.

sentences.text: Not **everything** you read online **is** true, so check your sources.
sentences.translation: Internetda o'qiganlaringizning **hammasi ham** to'g'ri **emas**, manbalarni tekshiring.

examples.title: Mixed: **all**, **every**, **whole** together
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: all, every, whole, everybody, everything — farqlarni bir gapda ko'rish.

sentences.text: I've been looking for my keys **all** morning — I've searched **every** room in the flat.
sentences.translation: **Ertalabdan beri** kalitlarimni qidiryapman — kvartiradagi **har bir** xonani qaradim.

sentences.text: **Everyone** enjoyed the concert, and **the whole** audience stood up at the end.
sentences.translation: Konsert **hammaga** yoqdi, oxirida **butun** zal o'rnidan turdi.

sentences.text: **All** I know about the new manager is that she comes from Oxford.
sentences.translation: Yangi menejer haqida **faqat** uning Oksforddan ekanini **bilaman**.

sentences.text: Madina reads the news **every** morning, but yesterday she was busy **all** day.
sentences.translation: Madina **har** kuni ertalab yangiliklarni o'qiydi, lekin kecha **kun bo'yi** band edi.

sentences.text: The fire destroyed **the whole** building, but **everybody** got out safely.
sentences.translation: Yong'in **butun** binoni vayron qildi, lekin **hamma** omon-eson chiqib oldi.

sentences.text: We spent **all** our savings on the trip, and it was worth **every** penny.
sentences.translation: Sayohatga **barcha** jamg'armamizni sarfladik va u **har bir** tiyiniga arzidi.

sentences.text: Not **every** hotel in Khiva accepts cards, so take some cash.
sentences.translation: Xivadagi mehmonxonalarning **hammasi ham** karta qabul qilavermaydi, shuning uchun naqd pul oling.

sentences.text: The teacher checked **every** answer, but she didn't have time to read **the whole** essay.
sentences.translation: O'qituvchi **har bir** javobni tekshirdi, lekin inshoni **to'liq** o'qishga vaqti yetmadi.

sentences.text: **Everything** went wrong on Monday: the car broke down and I missed **the whole** meeting.
sentences.translation: Dushanba kuni **hamma narsa** chappasiga ketdi: mashina buzildi va men majlisni **butunlay** o'tkazib yubordim.

sentences.text: **The whole of** Tashkent seemed to be at the bazaar on the day before the holiday.
sentences.translation: Bayram arafasida **butun** Toshkent bozorga chiqqandek tuyuldi.
